params.name: ReportId_or_Handle
params.description: The unique ID or handle for the report (e.g., '4222' or 'adv_click_data_pm_only').

params.name: SUBAID
params.description: Program ID to refine the report. Required for most reports.

params.name: StartDate
params.description: Start date for the report data as an ISO 8601 date-time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ), e.g. 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z. Required for most reports.

params.name: EndDate
params.description: End date for the report data as an ISO 8601 date-time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ), e.g. 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z. Required for most reports.

params.name: ResultFormat
params.description: The file format for the exported report.
